about: Inference latency budgets (roadmap 3.6, NATIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md 6.6), checked by `rudra-native bench --budget <this file> --machine <label>`.
Wall time to fields in host memory, fp32, median of the bench's runs on its synthetic frame, model sdr2hdr_shadow_v1.
Each budget is the machine's measured time plus 25 %, rounded up, so a slower build fails its gate instead of shipping. A row without a budget is reported, not checked.
rtx4080s-win: the RTX 4080 SUPER Windows PC, NATIVE_GATE_A.ps1 -Machine rtx4080s-win. 4K rows are added from that machine's first 4K run.

gh-ubuntu-24.04: GitHub's runner in the native workflow's parity job, CPU only. Loose on purpose (shared, noisy cores): it catches a debug build, a lost thread pool or an accidental tiling, not a few percent.
